artifact_type: planned test cases, not executed test results

case_table.worksheet_name: Any descriptive name; multiple case worksheets are acceptable.

fields.name: Test ID
fields.meaning: Unique reference for this planned case.

fields.name: Test Category
fields.meaning: Functional area covered by this case.

fields.name: Priority
fields.meaning: Risk-based priority, using a defined scale.

fields.name: Pass Criteria
fields.meaning: Acceptance condition, or explicit condition pending confirmation.

fields.name: Test Status
fields.meaning: Leave blank or mark Not Executed/Planned, as appropriate.

fields.name: Remarks
fields.meaning: Basis, assumptions, applicability, limitations or unresolved requirements.

case_table.equivalence: Equivalent English labels, merged evidence notes and reasonable sheet layouts are acceptable if the fields remain identifiable. No fixed case count or ID sequence is prescribed. Shared setup may be referenced explicitly by cases.
